---
name: Language request
about: Ask for a language to be added, or offer to help record one
labels: language
---

Thank you. A language needs two native speakers who read its standard spelling, and they are paid
for their time. See [`docs/languages.md`](../../docs/languages.md).

**Language name**

**ISO 639-3 code** (look it up at https://iso639-3.sil.org; leave blank if you are not sure)

**Region** (where it is spoken in Cameroon, for example Littoral or Northwest)

**Speakers available** (how many native speakers can record, and whether they can review each other's work)

**Community contact** (a name and a way to reach you, for example a language committee or a literacy programme; do not post personal phone numbers here)

**Anything else we should know** (existing written translations, a standard spelling, a voice you already have)
